beffroilille.name: Lille Belfry
beffroilille.slogan: A town hall tower that watches over the whole Flemish plain.
beffroilille.line: Inaugurated in 1932 and rising about 104 metres, it is one of the tallest town hall belfries in Europe and a UNESCO World Heritage site.

vieillebourse.name: Vieille Bourse
vieillebourse.slogan: Flemish baroque around a courtyard of chess and old paperbacks.
vieillebourse.line: Built in 1652-1653, the old exchange is a quadrangle of 24 houses around an inner courtyard, now home to second-hand book stalls.

dunkerque1940.name: Dunkirk 1940 Museum
dunkerque1940.slogan: Where 338,000 men were lifted off the beaches in nine days.
dunkerque1940.line: Wars are not won by evacuations.
dunkerque1940.by: Winston Churchill, House of Commons, 4 June 1940

bergues.name: Bergues Ramparts and Belfry
bergues.slogan: Flanders in miniature: bells, canals and 5 km of walls.
bergues.line: Bergues' belfry, rebuilt after 1944 and home to a carillon, is UNESCO-listed and starred in the 2008 film Bienvenue chez les Ch'tis.

pbalille.name: Palais des Beaux-Arts
pbalille.slogan: Goya, Rubens and Vauban's model towns under one grand roof.
pbalille.line: Opened in 1892, it is one of the largest fine art museums in France, with 18th-century relief models of fortified towns in its basement.
